direction: Small sculpted tabletop monster tokens, chunky readable shapes, saturated 16-bit palette. Armor and egg sacs must be visible geometry, not just recolors. No gore.

pieces.name: Tick
pieces.prompt: a squat green tick monster figurine, round abdomen, eight short thick legs, tiny face, matte painted clay

pieces.name: Iron Tick
pieces.prompt: a squat tick monster figurine in riveted steel armor, round armored abdomen, eight short thick legs, matte painted clay

pieces.name: Brood Tick
pieces.prompt: a squat green tick monster figurine carrying three cream egg sacs on its back, eight short thick legs, matte painted clay

pieces.name: Iron Brood Tick
pieces.prompt: a squat tick monster figurine, riveted steel shell carrying three cream egg sacs, eight short thick legs, matte painted clay

pieces.name: Tack
pieces.prompt: a single stout brass thumbtack game token, round emerald green head, short thick metal point

pieces.name: Toe
pieces.prompt: a single cartoon toe shaped ceramic game token, peach skin, cream toenail, rounded sealed base, no blood

pieces.name: Egg
pieces.prompt: a single speckled cream monster egg game token, squat rounded shape, small green spots, matte painted clay

pieces.name: Stone
pieces.prompt: a squat dark slate rock game token, large angular facets, moss green patch, matte painted clay

pieces.name: Lure
pieces.prompt: a squat amber bait bottle game token, round sealed glass flask, bright green bait inside, thick cork stopper

pieces.name: Wild Seed
pieces.prompt: a single round magical seed game token, green and purple split shell, small golden sprout, matte painted clay

pieces.name: Decoy Egg
pieces.prompt: a cream monster egg token with a brass tack tip and rose collar emerging from its shell, matte painted clay

pieces.name: Mimic Toe
pieces.prompt: a cartoon ceramic toe token disguising tiny green tick legs underneath, peach skin, cream toenail, matte painted clay

pieces.name: Hatchery Trap
pieces.prompt: a stout rose thumbtack token carrying two cream egg sacs beneath a wooden brace, matte painted clay
